title: PPO's clipped objective, and a PPO agent on CartPole
brief: Build PPO's clipped surrogate, entropy bonus, and KL diagnostics, check each against hand-computed values, then train an agent that balances CartPole.
hints: torch.min(ratio * adv, torch.clamp(ratio, 1 - eps, 1 + eps) * adv) is the whole clipped surrogate. Don't average it inside clipped_surrogate.
Use torch.log_softmax for the entropy, so a logit of 1000 doesn't produce log(0).

In ppo_loss, gather each sample's log-probability with torch.log_softmax(logits, -1).gather(-1, actions[:, None]).squeeze(-1). The loss is minus the surrogate, plus the value term, minus the entropy term.
In train_ppo, set the learning rate at the start of every iteration and index every tensor in the batch dict with the same minibatch indices.
